actual_scope: Sharp characteristic-two zero-primary capped spectral envelopes: every cap at corank one, and cap two at every idempotent rank; explicit binary attainment and the distinct globally nilpotent domain.
scope_change_reason: User-assigned continuation of Nick Petalas #5928 Open next question 2; a local algebraic side obligation rather than a new G20 word or supplier invoice. After the corank-one law, the lead authorized its complementary arbitrary-rank cap-two slice in the same package following scoped live overlap checks.
bottleneck_link: A finite native chain-length limit can reduce the local spectral surplus, but an actual caller must establish that this precise zero-primary cap applies and account for all targets and payments.
stop_rule: Stop at the two proved sharp slices and bounded corroboration. Do not expand to general higher-cap/higher-corank classification or a global funding claim.
evidence: PROOF.md proves the corank-one maximum r+largest odd integer <=m and arbitrary-rank cap-two maximum 2r-k. verify.py checks 66066 separate binary characteristic polynomials, 263714 corank-one pair/cap cases, 329780 all-rank ordered pairs and compression identities, 561 plus 594 constructions, and fifteen rejection controls. independent_oracle.py separately uses determinant polynomials and literal kernel vectors for all ranks over F2 through dimension four and F4 through dimension two.
